scope: Textbutler 0.8.23 version bump (claude/release-0.8.23): per-release coordinate agreement across package.json, site/package.json, src/version.ts, site/app/_lib/site.ts, the README and docs/message-like-me.md install lines, regenerated site/app/readme.generated.ts and dist/cli.js, site source-catalog pins, and the new CHANGELOG.md section, plus the receipt rebind because package.json is receipt-covered.

rounds.design: All surfaces agree at 0.8.23; generated files regenerated; changelog parses; receipt rebound to the bumped package.json (bun.lock unchanged).
blockers: Diff is limited to version coordinates, generated mirrors, the changelog section and qualification records; no product-behavior change.

result: Ship. Pure version-coordinate change consistent across all surfaces with the receipt rebound to the bumped manifest.
